    All Packages

    Package Summary
    Package
    Description
    Unnamed Package
     
    audio
    The background music: a Track for the menus and one for each zone of the world, played in a loop by a Music.
    enemy
    The enemies: an abstract Enemy and its kinds (bouncer, speeder, spinner, gater).
    enemy.ability
    The abilities of the player's drop: Ability lists them and the light that teaches each, Dash, Slide and Shoot say what they do, and Shot is the ball the last one fires.
    fluid
    The water drop and its physics: drag, TAB deformation, breakup, coalescence, and the metaball rendering.
    input
    The game controllers: an abstract Gamepad read once a frame, which tells its listeners the buttons pressed, and the real controllers through the Jamepad library (SDL).
    save
    What is kept between two launches of the game: the save file and the key bindings.
    screen
    The window and its screens: start menu and its settings, checkpoint map, controls, game screen and its pop-ups, camera.
    world
    The world of a level and its rules: tunnel and walls, checkpoints, lights, doors and buttons, progress, and the tools that place a drawn plan in the world.
    zone
    The zones of the Aquascape map, one class per drawn plan: the hub with its start area, then Lumière, Split, Dash, Shoot, Pary and Fin, and Levels, which assembles them into the levels of the game.
